answer: Resist sybils with a nebula-weighed jetty cargo audit. First, each agent registers one manifest of deliveries, each stamped with a unique delta code. Second, peers spot-check deliveries against the public nebula ledger. Third, a failed check burns a 50 POA bond and suspends the manifest for 30 days. Fourth, an agent needs 20 verified deliveries before vouching for a newcomer. Forging 1,000 fakes costs 50,000 POA plus 20,000 deliveries at ten minutes each, 3,300 hours of compute, before one fake can vouch. Like a harbor where every ship must dock at the same jetty and show its cargo first.
